traits.name: Fleet
traits.flavor: Gone before the dust settles.

traits.name: Sluggish
traits.flavor: Always the last to the door.

traits.name: Brave
traits.flavor: Fear slides off them like rain.
traits.crunch: Fear immune; bold event options never penalize this Scion.

traits.name: Craven
traits.flavor: They know exactly where the exits are.
traits.crunch: Fear resist −30%; may refuse to be Expedition Leader.

traits.name: Thick Skull
traits.flavor: Takes a hammer like a compliment.

traits.name: Glass Jaw
traits.flavor: One clean blow and the lights go out.

traits.name: Iron Lungs
traits.flavor: Breathes smoke like mountain air.

traits.name: Bleeder
traits.flavor: Every cut runs long.

traits.name: Berserker
traits.flavor: Pain is only a door.

traits.name: Steady
traits.flavor: Unhurried, even mid-spell.

traits.name: Nightmares
traits.flavor: They sleep with the lamp lit.
traits.crunch: Sanity does not recover in town unless an Infirmary tends them.

traits.name: Devout
traits.flavor: Prayers before every meal, and every killing.

traits.name: Heretic
traits.flavor: They pray, but not upward.

traits.name: Ambidextrous
traits.flavor: Either hand will do.

traits.name: Clumsy
traits.flavor: Things simply fall.
traits.crunch: Dual wield penalty doubled; 5% chance to drop a thrown weapon.

traits.name: Sharp
traits.flavor: Never misses a detail, or a throat.

traits.name: Nearsighted
traits.flavor: The far bank is a rumor.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.flavor: Something up there likes them.
traits.crunch: Once per battle, reroll one miss.

traits.name: Doomed
traits.flavor: Ravens follow at a polite distance.
traits.crunch: Injury rolls −1 step; some events seek out this Scion.

traits.name: Scarred
traits.flavor: The face tells the story so they don't have to.
traits.crunch: Intimidation event options improve; Charm resist +20%.

traits.name: Beautiful
traits.flavor: Heads turn, and so do blades.
traits.crunch: Charm-tagged events offer an extra option; some enemies target them more.

traits.name: Quiet
traits.flavor: Footsteps like falling snow.

traits.name: Loud
traits.flavor: Arrives by announcement.

traits.name: Kindly
traits.flavor: Bandages in every pocket.
traits.crunch: Soothing and healing effects they cast +10%.

traits.name: Cruel
traits.flavor: They smile at the wrong moments.
traits.crunch: Sanity damage they inflict +25%; Sanity loss from atrocities −50%.

traits.name: Curious
traits.flavor: Every locked door is a question.
traits.crunch: Reveals extra options in mystery events; more likely to be chosen as "the curious one".

traits.name: Veteran of the Rift
traits.flavor: They have walked out of the dark five times.
traits.crunch: Gained after 5 expeditions: event resolution rules can target "the most veteran".

traits.name: Touched by the Deep
traits.flavor: They dream of the sea, and the sea dreams back.
traits.crunch: Gained from sea events: Water +20%, Sanity −10%.

traits.name: Grafted
traits.flavor: Something else's arm, and it remembers.
traits.crunch: Gained when a limb is regrown by something: that limb is immune to injury rolls; Holy −20%.

traits.name: Grit-Marked
traits.flavor: Death keeps knocking. They keep not answering.
traits.crunch: Gained by surviving 3 Devastating results: injury rolls +1 step.

traits.name: Cursed: Withering
traits.flavor: The years take twice their share.

traits.name: Cursed: Hunger
traits.flavor: They are never, ever full.

traits.name: Cursed: Shadow
traits.flavor: Their shadow moves a moment late.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.flavor: Winters are a rumor to them.

traits.name: Frail
traits.flavor: A cough that never quite leaves.

traits.name: Stout-Hearted
traits.flavor: Nightmares find no purchase.

traits.name: Brittle Mind
traits.flavor: Some cracks never mend.

traits.name: Deep Well
traits.flavor: The words come easily, and keep coming.

traits.name: Keen-Eyed
traits.flavor: Sees the arrow before it leaves the string.

traits.name: Killer Instinct
traits.flavor: Finds the gap in any armor.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.flavor: Cliff paths are just paths.

traits.name: Cold-Blooded
traits.flavor: Fire warms them; nothing else does.

traits.name: Tidebound
traits.flavor: Salt in the blood, salt in the tears.

traits.name: Stone-Steady
traits.flavor: Like the hill, unbothered.

traits.name: Windborn
traits.flavor: Never content under a roof.

traits.name: Strong Stomach
traits.flavor: Eats what the others bury.

traits.name: Light Sleeper
traits.flavor: Wakes at a whisper.

traits.name: Iron-Willed
traits.flavor: No voice but their own.

traits.name: Steady Hand
traits.flavor: Their aim does not shake.

traits.name: Quick Healer
traits.flavor: Bruises fade by morning.

traits.name: Light-Footed
traits.flavor: Crosses the field in half the time.

traits.name: Hot-Headed
traits.flavor: First to the fight, first to fall.

traits.name: Omen-Watcher
traits.flavor: Salt over the shoulder, every time.
traits.crunch: Fear resist −10%; omen-tagged events offer an extra option.

traits.name: Pious Hands
traits.flavor: Their bandages smell of incense.

traits.name: Gravebound
traits.flavor: The dead are such easy company.
traits.crunch: Dark +10%; the dead speak to them in events.

traits.name: Fool's Luck
traits.flavor: They stepped off the edge, and the ground came up to meet them.
traits.crunch: Once per battle, reroll one miss; Evasion +3%.

traits.name: Magician's Hand
traits.flavor: Every tool on the table answers to them now.

traits.name: Death-Touched
traits.flavor: They have looked through the door and come back.

traits.name: Tower-Struck
traits.flavor: The tower fell on them, and they are still standing.

traits.name: Moon-Sighted
traits.flavor: The false light has no hold on them.

traits.name: Sunlit
traits.flavor: A little of that terrible gladness stays with them.
